title: TSJ WaterPark
description: TSJ WakePark, in the south of France, the best place for water sports! You can enjoy our cable wakeboarding, the water slide, a water park, a restaurant, and much more!
error_html5: Your browser does not support HTML5. Please update your browser to view this site.
welcome_p1: The Saint Jean cable ski in the Eastern Pyrenees (66) is the southernmost in France. Located between Perpignan and the Spanish border, come and discover our 5-pylon and 2-pylon cable ski, the Water Jump, the Aquapark, and the La Paillote restaurant in an exceptional setting.
welcome_p2: On Lake Saint-Jean Pla de Corts, in Vallespir, sheltered from the wind!
welcome_p3: From beginners to professionals, and from ages 7 to 77, our cable ski and our team of qualified instructors are at your disposal to enjoy unforgettable skiing moments with friends, alone, or with family. Make the most of your holidays—thrills guaranteed!
